newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 10.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* After completing the TriStar sci-fi pic "Starship Troopers," Paul Verhoeven is in negotiations to direct the Columbia film "Houdini."

* Bowing to pressure from elected officials and kidvid advocates, broadcasters -- with the important exception of General Electric's NBC -- have agreed to add symbols to their current content code to indicate if a show includes sex, violence or adult language.
* Time Warner's Warner Bros picked up the spec "The Road Home" from Houston playwright Tom Vaughan for an undisclosed sum.

* In the wake of senior vice president Scott Greenstein's departure, Miramax Films has promoted Steven Hutensky to senior VP of business and legal affairs and Andrew Herwitz to senior veepee of acquisitions and business affairs.
* Walt Disney's ABC tapped two in-house producers to revamp the struggling "Good Morning America" gabfest.
* Banks and investment firms are eagerly lending money to independent film producers on the promise of future sales.
